function.description: Cancel an existing appointment. The tool decides whether a cancellation fee applies — you do not, and you must never waive one. State the fee it returns before confirming. If the caller disputes it, escalate rather than arguing.
function.name: cancelAppointment

bookingRef.description: Booking reference exactly as it was given to you, e.g. bk-3QR9.

feeAcknowledged.description: Set true only after stating the cancellation fee and hearing the caller accept it.

messages.content: I'm having trouble cancelling that appointment.
